verdict.rationale: The docs list Transaction Data Services that return account transaction data, plus first-party 'insights into transaction types, recurring transactions, consumer spending'. That implies some platform-side classification of raw transactions, which is roughly the categorization part of enrichment. No item explicitly documents enrichment as such. Missing for 10: documented merchant-name cleaning, an explicit category taxonomy on transaction records, merchant logos, field-level enrichment docs, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
